subject: Module allocation and tier choice synthesis for Catalyst pilot
messages:
From: Simon Han <simon.han@catalyst.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Morgan <ava.morgan@catalyst.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T15:04:00Z
Subject: Packaging options for upcoming pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — Catalyst's ML infra team and product leads are aligned on running a 6‑week pilot for our clinical summarization feature. Before we lock dates, procurement asked for a clear packaging recommendation: can you outline the upgrade/downgrade paths and whether we should (a) bump our hosted tier to the Throughput profile, or (b) reserve a Dedicated pool for predictable latency?

Key constraints:
- We need p95 latency under 600ms for 1–2k concurrent requests.
- Procurement prefers a 30–60 day pilot commitment but can consider a 12‑month seat for a discount.
- We must preserve our quantization/FP16 inference pipeline if possible.

Can you provide:
1) A short comparison (cost delta, expected latency, feature availability) for Tier vs Dedicated for our current workload,
2) A clear rollback path if we need to step down mid‑pilot, and
3) Any packaging recommendations on observability / KV cache / prefix caching as add‑ons.

If you can send a one‑page with the options, I’ll circulate to procurement and legal.

Thanks,
Simon
Simon Han | Head of Platform, Catalyst Health
[simon.han@catalyst.ai]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Packaging options for upcoming pilot

Simon — thanks, this is exactly the right set of asks. I put together two concise paths below and attached a short proposal + a mapping spreadsheet that lays feature-per-tier side-by-side. High level first, then next steps.

Option A — Tier upgrade (hosted)
- What it gives: immediate throughput uplift (Throughput profile), automatic batching, prefix/KV caching, standard observability (per-route latency & token cost).
- Expected performance: p50 ~120–180ms, p95 typically ~450–550ms for your traffic shape (estimated from the sample trace you shared).
- Cost: ~+20% over current monthly hosted spend for the pilot envelope (ballpark — see attached worksheet).
- Rollback: instant stepdown via console; billing prorated for the change month. No infra changes needed.

Option B — Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool)
- What it gives: dedicated GPU pool, pinned model/quantization profile, predictable p95 <600ms even with concurrent bursts, isolated data plane.
- Expected performance: p50 ~90–140ms, p95 ~300–500ms depending on request packing — matches your SLA target.
- Pricing: reserve a pilot pool (2x A100 equiv.) for the 6‑week pilot — estimated $12,000/month (pilot rate). We can include a 15% commitment discount for a 12‑month commit.
- Rollback: we keep the pool reserved for the committed window; we offer a short-term stepdown to a smaller pool with a 30‑day notice and a prorated credit for unused time.

Feature bundling guidance
- Observability: Advanced Observability (AOM) is recommended if you want token-level tracing and alerting; add as an opt‑in for the pilot.
- KV/prefix caching: Recommended for consistent latency reductions; activated by config for hosted tiers, included in Dedicated pipelines.
- Quantization: Dedicated makes it simpler to pin a quantized variant — we can lock to your FP16/INT8 profile. For hosted tiers we can pin a model variant, but rollouts are more controlled in Dedicated.

Discount / procurement notes
- 12‑month commit -> 15% discount on Dedicated reserves.
- Volume thresholds (>=10M tokens/mo) can trigger an additional 5% rebate.
- For short pilots we generally avoid heavy legal concessions; we can do pilot SOW + PO.

Next steps (mutual action plan)
1) Workshop (30–45m) with your infra + product to validate the sample traces and confirm p95 target (I propose Wed 12/21 9am PT).
2) I’ll attach a one‑page cost comparison and spreadsheet (attached) for procurement.
3) If you prefer Dedicated, I’ll include a templated pilot SOW and our 12‑month term pricing (with the 15% discount) for legal to review.

Attached: catalyst_proposal_v2.pdf (one‑pager), mux_mapping.xlsx (feature ↔ tier matrix).

Happy to loop in Marissa (CC’d) for pricing flexibility and Lauren (ops) if you want deeper infra detail — I included both on the CC.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. Quick clarifying questions before we take this to procurement:

1) Quantization: can the Dedicated pool guarantee the FP16 profile you mentioned? We cannot tolerate regressions in summary fidelity.
2) SLA specifics: can you put the expected p50/p95 numbers in the one‑pager with the test payload you used? Procurement wants concrete numbers they can compare to other vendors.
3) Pricing: that $12k/month estimate — is that fully loaded (includes observability add‑on) or is that strictly bare compute? If observability is extra, how much?
4) Discounts: procurement will push for a blended discount if we do a 12‑month commit plus a 2x pilot conversion to production. Are you able to negotiate an additional 5% in that scenario?

Procurement also asked to include our legal contact on the next exchange. Copying Ava so she can provide the contact details. Our target: sign off on the pilot SOW by 12/30.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — if you can update the one‑pager with explicit p95 numbers and a line‑item cost for observability, we’ll move to procurement.

—Simon

Simon / Ava — following up with the concrete numbers you asked for. I updated the one‑pager and attached a short pricing table and the mapping sheet. Key points below (numbers are estimated based on the traces you provided and our performance models):

Performance (sample payload = 512 tokens, 5 concurrent streams per user)- Hosted Throughput profile: p50 130ms, p95 520ms (may exceed 600ms under extreme bursts)- Dedicated (2x A100 equiv. reserved pool): p50 95ms, p95 380–480ms

Pricing (pilot, December/January cadence)- Hosted Tier upgrade: +20% on current hosted invoice (~$2,400 incremental / month on your pilot envelope). Observability standard included; Advanced Observability add‑on = +$1,100 / month.- Dedicated reserve (pilot pool): $12,000 / month baseline (compute + platform ops). Dedicated with Advanced Observability bundled = $13,000 / month.

Discounting scenarios- 12‑month commit on Dedicated: 15% off baseline reserved rate (pilot price would drop to ~$10,200/mo).- Blended conversion concession (12‑month + planned production conversion within 90 days): we can approve an additional 5% one‑time rebate applied to the first quarter of production billing. That would be a formal negotiable term in the SOW.

Quantization and fidelity- Dedicated: we can pin the FP16 variant and freeze model rollouts for your pool; we will include a fidelity check-run during onboarding (two test prompts + evaluation metrics you provide).- Hosted: we can pin a model variant but not freeze global rollouts — fidelity gates available via a rollout policy (we recommend Dedicated if fidelity must be absolutely invariant).

Rollback & operational guardrails- Hosted: instant UI stepdown; billing prorated.- Dedicated: we offer a downsize path with 30 days notice and prorated credits if you reduce reserved capacity mid‑term. For pilot-to-prod conversion we can stage sizing so the risk of overcommit is limited.

Next steps (recommended)
1) Workshop — Wed 12/21 09:00 PT (30m) to validate traces + fidelity checks.
2) I’ll send an updated pilot SOW (non‑binding draft) and the finalized one‑pager for procurement.
3) If you want negotiated blended discounts, Marissa (CC) will run the concession approval with finance — Marissa, can you flag the 5% rebate scenario for review?

Links and attachments
- One‑pager (attached): catalyst_proposal_v2.pdf
- Feature mapping: mux_mapping.xlsx
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

If that looks good I’ll queue the draft SOW and loop in our legal / finance folks so procurement has a single document to review.

Thanks — Ben
